title: What Earth's horizon costs
summary: At the south pole Earth sits low on the horizon, and ridges hide it. Without a relay, the base delivers {{r:dte_loss}} less cargo a year.
summary_plain: At the south pole Earth sits low on the horizon, and ridges hide it. Without a relay, the base delivers 42 % less cargo a year.
notes: Skeleton for E21 (results/table_E21.csv, table_E21_breakeven.csv, written by experiments/phase4/run_phase4.py table). Every number is pending until those tables exist; check the row selectors against the final tables then. Wording for LEAD to edit.

always_t.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = always, mix = supervised_strict, column delivered_t_in_year; Earth always in view (the baseline), all supervised rovers, strict policy (experiment E21 stage A)

dte_t.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = dte, mix = supervised_strict, column delivered_t_in_year; direct-to-Earth links only (experiment E21 stage A)

dte_loss.source: pct_change of always_t and dte_t (unrounded); neg

dte_wait.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = dte, mix = supervised_strict, column blackout_wait_vehicle_h; rover time spent waiting for Earth in the year

dte_refused.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = dte, mix = supervised_strict, column blackout_jobs_refused; jobs no rover could start for want of a link

relay_t.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = dte+relay, coverage = 0.1, mix = supervised_strict, column delivered_t_in_year; a relay satellite in view a tenth of the time, besides direct links

auto_t.source: results/table_E21.csv, row stage = A, comms = dte, mix = autonomous, column delivered_t_in_year; direct links only, fully autonomous rovers

relay_gain.source: results/table_E21_breakeven.csv, row option = relay coverage 0.1, column gain_vs_dte; gain over direct links only, all supervised rovers, strict policy (experiment E21 break-even table)

rover_gain.source: results/table_E21_breakeven.csv, row option = +1 supervised LTV, column gain_vs_dte; gain of one extra supervised LTV over direct links only (experiment E21 stage B)

steps.title: Earth hangs on the horizon
steps.text: Seen from the south pole Earth never climbs high. Ridges and crater rims hide it for days at a time, and supervised rovers need a link to Earth to drive.
steps.visual: Earth low over the ridge; the shadow of the terrain marks where it is hidden.
steps.text_plain: Seen from the south pole Earth never climbs high. Ridges and crater rims hide it for days at a time, and supervised rovers need a link to Earth to drive.
steps.visual_plain: Earth low over the ridge; the shadow of the terrain marks where it is hidden.

steps.title: Waiting for Earth
steps.text: With direct links only, rovers spend {{r:dte_wait}} a year waiting for Earth to rise, and {{r:dte_refused}} cannot start at all.
steps.visual: Rovers parked at the base in the waiting colour while Earth is below the ridge.
steps.text_plain: With direct links only, rovers spend 972 rover-hours a year waiting for Earth to rise, and 13 jobs cannot start at all.
steps.visual_plain: Rovers parked at the base in the waiting colour while Earth is below the ridge.

steps.title: The cargo it costs
steps.text: The base delivers {{r:dte_t}} instead of {{r:always_t}}: {{r:dte_loss}} less.
steps.visual: The delivery counter of the year, with and without the horizon.
steps.text_plain: The base delivers 307 t per year instead of 532 t per year: 42 % less.
steps.visual_plain: The delivery counter of the year, with and without the horizon.

steps.title: A relay, or autonomy
steps.text: A relay satellite that is in view only part of the time already restores most of it: {{r:relay_t}}. Autonomous rovers that need no link reach {{r:auto_t}}.
steps.visual: A relay link drawn from the rovers to a satellite passing overhead.
steps.text_plain: A relay satellite that is in view only part of the time already restores most of it: 530 t per year. Autonomous rovers that need no link reach 532 t per year.
steps.visual_plain: A relay link drawn from the rovers to a satellite passing overhead.

steps.title: More rovers cannot buy it back
steps.text: A relay in view a tenth of the time adds {{r:relay_gain}}. One more supervised rover adds {{r:rover_gain}}: it waits for Earth like the others.
steps.visual: The base with its rover fleet, an extra rover drawn faded and parked in the waiting colour.
steps.title_plain: More rovers cannot buy it back
steps.text_plain: A relay in view a tenth of the time adds 224 t per year. One more supervised rover adds 0.6 t per year: it waits for Earth like the others.
steps.visual_plain: The base with its rover fleet, an extra rover drawn faded and parked in the waiting colour.
